simdjson.note: Singleheader amalgamation (simdjson.cpp + simdjson.h), fetched directly as release assets -- no build step, compiled straight into the extension. Used for decode only (DOM API); simdjson has no JSON-writing API.

yyjson.note: Already a single .c/.h pair at the repo root (src/yyjson.c, src/yyjson.h) -- no amalgamation needed, fetched directly from the tagged ref. Used for encode (writer API) and for reading $schema documents (schema is always small, no need for simdjson's speed there).
